opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations, private owners of a heritage asset and partnerships. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members that are not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £10,000 to £250,000. Funds projects that value, care for and sustain heritage, taking into account the four investment principles (saving heritage, protecting the environment, inclusion/access/participation, organisational sustainability). No deadline; apply whenever ready, decision within eight weeks.

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by not-for-profit organisations. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members that are not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK from £250,000 to £10m. Requires an Expression of Interest first, then a development phase (up to two years) and a delivery phase (no more than five years). Quarterly application deadlines. For grants under £1m applicants must contribute at least 5% of project costs; over £1m at least 10%.
